title: Wave state (.foundry/releases/<id>/state.yaml)
description: What one wave learned, for the next wave's /foundry:intake to read before it asks anything (feat wave-learn, AC-WVL-1/-2). Four list top-level keys plus the optional scalar next_action (feat programme-state-minimal, AC-PSM-1), no per-atom status -- run-state is DERIVED (foundry_release.derive_run_state), never restated here. Written by the command deck at wave close (scripts/foundry_command_deck.py write_wave_state) and merged, never overwritten: a write must never drop an existing list entry; next_action REPLACES rather than accumulates.

decisions.description: Dated, one-line decisions the wave made that the next wave should not re-litigate.

artifacts.description: Reusable outputs of the wave -- a file worth citing or copying forward, not restating.

reuse_as.description: How the next wave should use it -- a template, a reference implementation, a definition to cite.

open_risks.description: Risks or loose ends the wave found but did not close, named so the next wave inherits them deliberately rather than by accident.

amendments_needed.description: Spec/contract amendments reality forced during the wave, recorded here so the next wave's authoring starts from what actually shipped.

next_action.description: Optional. The single next thing to do, so a tick prompt or a fresh session opens with it instead of re-deriving it. Not a list -- a write with next_action set REPLACES it, never accumulates; a write that omits it leaves whatever is already on disk untouched (feat programme-state-minimal, AC-PSM-1).
